examples.name: Sample — a public law with sidenotes
paragraphs: 15 USC 7215. and Establishment. in the right margin, level with SEC. 105. and (a) IN GENERAL.; the body is set in one narrower column. The small capitals of IN GENERAL are transcribed as capitals. The heading depth is relative: the page does not show the outline above the section.

snippets.text:
## SEC. 105. INVESTIGATIONS AND DISCIPLINARY PROCEEDINGS.

15 USC 7215.
(a) IN GENERAL.—The Board shall establish, by rule, subject to the requirements of this section, fair procedures for the investigation and disciplining of registered public accounting firms and associated persons of such firms.
Establishment.
